policy.availability_assumption: Minute candles available at their end; feed latency unmeasured
policy.capture_overlap: One-hour captures must agree exactly with saved first-15-minute candles
policy.common_time: First qualifying minute for the union of required assets across all configurations and benchmarks
policy.limitation: Trade marks are not executable quotes or evidence of Revolut X fills
policy.missing_reference: Stop for investigation; never drop assets or fabricate prices
policy.reference: Latest completed positive-volume minute candle close
policy.targets: Fixed at midnight; do not rerank while waiting
